What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?




By default, an instance that you launch within an Amazon VPC can't communicate with a local
        (AWS Cloud) network and a remote device — for example, this might be a site or an
        on-premises device. You can enable access to your remote devices from your VPC by creating
        an AWS Site-to-Site VPN (Site-to-Site VPN) connection, and configuring routing to pass traffic through the
        connection.
